title: Blackout vs. Freeze: Analyzing Physical Failure Modes of VLAs under Camera Faults
abstract: arXiv:2609.39145v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unreliable visual inputs can harm task performance and cause potential physical safety risks for vision-language-action (VLA) models. We analyze how $\pi 0.5$ and GR00T models act under input faults such as image blackouts and freezing. We find that blackout and freezing produce distinct physical failure modes even when task-success rates are similarly low: freezing causes more extreme joint behavior, whereas blackout after gripper closure can cause more object drops, most markedly without proprioception. Selective intervention studies reveal that proprioception (current robot state) partly compensates for the removed robot depictions and reduces non-target contact. However, it cannot sufficiently restore task success when wrist-view object information is removed, even when aided by the remaining scene view. We then evaluate two mitigation approaches: camera-blackout training and training-free replacement of faulty visual embeddings. B

translated_title: 黑屏 vs. 冻结：分析视觉-语言-动作模型在相机故障下的物理失效模式
translated_abstract: 不可靠的视觉输入会损害视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的任务表现，并带来潜在的物理安全风险。我们分析了 π0.5 和 GR00T 模型在图像黑屏和冻结等输入故障下的行为表现。我们发现，即使任务成功率同样较低，黑屏和冻结仍会产生截然不同的物理失效模式：冻结会导致更极端的关节行为，而夹爪闭合后的黑屏则可能导致更多物体掉落，在没有本体感觉（proprioception）时最为明显。选择性干预研究揭示，本体感觉（即机器人当前状态）能够在一定程度上补偿被移除的机器人表征，并减少非目标接触。然而，当腕部视角的物体信息被移除时，即使有剩余场景视角的辅助，本体感觉也无法充分恢复任务成功率。随后，我们评估了两种缓解方法：相机黑屏训练以及无需训练的故障视觉嵌入替换。
tldr: 该论文分析了 VLA 模型（π0.5 和 GR00T）在相机黑屏与冻结两种故障下表现出截然不同的物理失效模式——冻结导致更极端的关节行为，而夹爪闭合后的黑屏在缺乏本体感觉时导致更多物体掉落——并评估了相机黑屏训练与免训练视觉嵌入替换两种缓解方法。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that VLA models (π0.5 and GR00T) exhibit distinct physical failure modes under camera faults—freezing causes extreme joint behavior while blackout after gripper closure causes more object drops without proprioception—and evaluates two mitigations: camera-blackout training and training-free replacement of faulty visual embeddings.
